header: Several quotes, shown one at a time
lead: The row scrolls without a script: drag it, swipe it, or tab in and use the arrow keys. Two buttons help mouse users and grey out at either end.

quotes.quote_text: Each card is a figure: a blockquote for the words, a figcaption for the person and a portrait if there is one.
quotes.author: The first card
quotes.role: Every card has the same layout

image.alternative: A man in his fifties with grey stubble and a dark gilet.

quotes.quote_text: Two to twelve quotes. Below 768px the arrows are hidden, because swiping works better on a touch screen.
quotes.author: The second card
quotes.role: All cards have the same height

image.alternative: A woman in her fifties with short grey hair and a dark jacket.

quotes.quote_text: This is the only element in the content group with a script hook. The hook adds nothing the browser already does.

quotes.role: Its script is part of the shared runtime
